NAME:
   rancher kubeconfig - Print an exec-credential kubeconfig for a cluster, with its direct endpoint contexts when the cluster has them

USAGE:
   rancher kubeconfig [flags]

FLAGS:
   --cluster id|name       cluster id|name to generate the kubeconfig for
   --exec-command command  command kubectl runs for the exec plugin: a name looked up on PATH where kubectl runs, or a path, made absolute from the working directory (a leading ~ is the home directory); default rancher
   --help, -h              show help

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
